text:
Eva L: quick check-in for the perf sprint — we have three milestone checkpoints this week: kernel unitization (Weds), continuous-batching rollout (Thurs), KV cache hotfix and metric sweep (Fri). can owners confirm status?
Jamal R: I own kernel unitization; still on track but found a perf regression with the new int8 kernel for seq>2048. reproducer in #kernel-ci attached.
Mike P: looking at the int8 regression now, likely a kernel scheduling issue. @Jamal R can you paste the minimal repro? also pinging PR #4212 for review.
Jamal R: copied minimal repro: `python repro.py --model gptx --seq 4096 --batch 8` — happens deterministically on our perf harness. PR link: https://git.redwood/rl/kernel/4212
Ana T: continuous-batching rollout: canary on staging passed latency SLO for short contexts but tail p99 jumped on long-contexts, investigating whether batching is causing KV cache pressure.
Priya S: KV cache team looking into eviction behavior with continuous batching; we saw cache thrash in the canary logs (evict rate spiked). working on a soft-cap fix that reduces eviction churn.
Eva L: ownership note: kernel team owns kernel implementation and microbenchmarks; runtime infra owns batching orchestration; KV cache team owns cache policy. any objections?
Mike P: agree. runtime infra will add a telemetry tag so we can correlate batches -> evictions. I can add the tag before Thurs.
Jamal R: timeline: fix int8 kernel by EOD tomorrow if spike is small, otherwise fallback to int16 in production build. Mike, will need a quick review for the fallback switch (small shim).
Ana T: can we keep the canary window open longer on Thursday to capture long-tail behavior? recommend 2 hours instead of 30m.
Priya S: +1 to extended canary. also will push a patch to reduce aggressive eviction heuristics (PR #788).
Mike P: PR #4212 reviewed, left one nit. @Jamal R PTAL, then I'll approve and merge.
Jamal R: addressed nit, pushed update. moving to run perf suite.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: runtime-batching-canary -> staging at 2025-11-21T14:30Z. status: pending.
Ana T: note for ops: if you see p99 > 450ms during canary, auto-roll back. added that to canary policy.
Priya S: KV patch merged to staging branch, will monitor eviction metrics during canary.
Mike P: landed fallback shim to int16 into staging as precaution.
Jamal R: perf suite results: int8 regression reproduces, but after a scheduling tweak we regain ~12% perf and p99 stabilizes. pushing updated kernel artifact.
Eva L: awesome. blockers? anything that would move our Fri KV sweep milestone?
Priya S: remaining blocker: need kernel artifact with the scheduling tweak to validate end-to-end. ETA 2 hours.
Mike P: I'll run the end-to-end smoke tests once artifact is up, then signal canary go/no-go.
Ana T: I'll extend canary window and watch p95/p99. will post results here.
Jamal R: artifact uploaded: build-175320-art-ker-sched.tgz -> staging.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: runtime-batching-canary -> staging at 2025-11-21T15:01Z.
Mike P: smoke tests passing on staging (short + long contexts). marking ready for extended canary.
Ana T: canary metrics: p95 steady, p99 improved vs previous, eviction-rate down 60%. Looks good so far.
Eva L: thanks all. next steps: merge kernel hotfix to main after one more overnight perf run, baking period for KV policy changes, and a post-mortem doc if we hit any regression after rollout. I'll follow up with an ownership matrix and updated milestone dates.
Priya S: I'll draft the KV changelog and metrics dashboard by EOD.
Mike P: tagging a couple of related PRs for release notes: #4212, #788, #4321.
Jamal R: any code review help needed tomorrow morning? I may be offline early but can triage comments later.
Eva L: thanks — ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
